snippets.title: Data Migration Script
snippets.code:
import requests
import csv
from jira import JIRA

jira = JIRA(
  server='https://company.atlassian.net',
  basic_auth=('email@company.com', 'api_token')
)

def migrate_issues(csv_file):
  with open(csv_file, 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
      issue_dict = {
        'project': {'key': row['project']},
        'summary': row['subject'],
        'description': row['description'],
        'issuetype': {'name': map_issue_type(row['tracker'])},
        'priority': {'name': map_priority(row['priority'])},
        'assignee': {'name': row['assigned_to']}
      }
      
      new_issue = jira.create_issue(fields=issue_dict)
      
      migrate_comments(row['id'], new_issue.key)
      migrate_attachments(row['id'], new_issue.key)
      
migrateissues('redmine_export.csv')

frontend.name: Custom Jira Workflows
frontend.code:
# Software Development Workflow

## Statuses
- Backlog (Initial)
- Ready for Development
- In Progress
- Code Review
- QA Testing
- Ready for Release
- Done (Final)

## Transitions
1. Backlog → Ready for Development
   - Condition: Story points assigned
   - Validators: All required fields filled

2. Ready for Development → In Progress
   - Post-function: Assign to developer
   - Post-function: Update sprint

3. In Progress → Code Review
   - Condition: Pull request created
   - Validators: Code coverage > 80%

4. Code Review → QA Testing
   - Condition: PR approved by 2+ reviewers
   - Post-function: Assign to QA team

5. QA Testing → Ready for Release
   - Condition: All test cases passed
   - Post-function: Add to release version

6. Ready for Release → Done
   - Post-function: Close linked sub-tasks
   - Post-function: Update velocity metrics

backend.name: Jira Automation Rules
backend.code:
# Auto-assign based on component
Trigger: Issue Created
Conditions:
  - Component = Frontend
Actions:
  - Assign to: Frontend Team Lead
  - Add comment: "Auto-assigned to frontend team"

# Slack notification for high priority bugs
Trigger: Issue Updated
Conditions:
  - Issue Type = Bug
  - Priority = High or Critical
  - Status changed
Actions:
  - Send Slack message to #engineering
  - Message: "High priority bug {{issue.key}}: {{issue.summary}}"

# Auto-close stale issues
Trigger: Scheduled (Weekly)
Conditions:
  - Status = Waiting for Response
  - Updated date < 30 days ago
Actions:
  - Transition to: Closed
  - Add comment: "Auto-closed due to inactivity"
  - Send email to reporter

- Repository: company/backend-services
- Smart Commits: Enabled

- PR linking: Automatic

- Channels:

  - #engineering (High priority)

# Confluence Integration
- Space: Engineering
- Auto-link: Requirements to Epics
- Page creation: From Epic template
- Meeting notes: Linked to sprint

# Microsoft Teams Integration
- Team: Engineering
- Notifications: Daily standup summary
- Bot commands: /jira create, /jira search
